facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports the Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation piloted a Unified Digital Civil Registration Service in 19 districts on 10 August 2025, with national rollout planned in phases.
Ecofin Agency says the pilot platform enables local administrations to digitally register births, marriages, divorces and deaths, stored in a central national database.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation
